title: NLO QCD corrections to the electroweak production of a Higgs boson pair in the quark-antiquark channel
family_label_in_paper: Fig.1a double box = family PL of ref.[35] arXiv:2503.16620
description: 2-loop planar 4-point double box, 2 massless + 2 Higgs legs (mH^2), 3 internal lines of mass mV; 45 canonical MIs, polylogarithmic
mapping_notes: p1,p2 massless, p3^2=p4^2=mH^2, sum p=0, s=(p1+p2)^2, t=(p1+p3)^2, u=(p2+p3)^2=2mH^2-s-t. Independent p1,p2,p3: p1.p2=s/2, p1.p3=(t-mH2)/2, p2.p3=(u-mH2)/2. Euclidean requires s,t<0 AND mH2<mV2 (x2x4x7 coefficient mV2-mH2), so the physical ratio mH2/mV2=625/256 cannot be kept. The second top sector (Fig.1b of 2601.16924, 6 extra MIs) has no propagator list in text/ancillary -> not written.
normalization: 2503.16620 eq.(2): e^{2eps gamma_E}(mV^2)^{2eps} prod d^Dk/(i pi^{D/2}), D=q^2-m^2 (+i delta). DiffExp FT: denominators D=m^2-q^2 (Euclidean-positive), measure prod d^dk/(i pi^{d/2}), no exp(L eps gamma_E) (see de22/docs/amflow-comparison.md, feynman-families.md). Paper Minkowski integral with (q^2-m^2+i0) denominators = (-1)^{sum nu} * DiffExp value (numerator powers included in sum nu).
confidence: medium-high: definition verbatim from 2503.16620, identified with Fig.1a via '45 integrals' statement. Papers print only amplitude/form-factor values (2601.16924 Table 2 at s=3125/128,t=-1875/128,u=-625/128,mV2=1; 2503.16620 Table 6), no master-integral values.
